channel.title: Cisco Meraki incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Cisco Meraki's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Camera API error [resolved]
item.description: Our teams have successfully mitigated the issue that was affecting customers. It has been confirmed that the the generateSnapshot Camera API endpoint is responding as expected. If you continue to have issues, please contact Customer Support.

item.title: API Outage [resolved]
item.description: The issue with API responses has been Resolved. If you continue to see issues with failed API calls, please reach out to Customer Support.

item.title: Dashboard issues with Live Data [resolved]
item.description: Our teams have confirmed that the prior issues regarding Live Tools and/or viewing live data for network devices have been resolved. All systems are now operating normally. If you continue to see issues, please contact Meraki Customer Support.

item.title: Dashboard issues with Live data [resolved]
item.description: Our teams have confirmed that the prior issues regarding Live Tools and/or viewing live data for network devices have been resolved. All systems are now operating normally. If you continue to see issues, please contact Meraki Customer Support.

item.title: Cloud connectivity [resolved]
item.description: This incident is now resolved. All systems should be operating normally at this time. If you continue to experience issues, please feel free to contact Customer Support.

item.title: Meraki Support Phone Outage [resolved]
item.description: The issues connecting to the Support team via phone are now resolved. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Meraki Support Phone Outage [resolved]
item.description: The issue involving customers being unable to reach our support team via phone has been resolved. If you continue to experience issues attempting to contact us via our Support Hotline please follow these steps. For new cases please open a case and choose the "Call In" option, for existing cases please provide a case comment with the phrase "10-15-Outage" and we will reach out to you as soon as possible.

item.title: MX DDNS issues [resolved]
item.description: The mitigation for the earlier MX (firewall) DDNS issues has been fully propagated and verified. Normal DDNS functionality has been restored to all MX (firewall) devices. If you continue to have issues, please contact Meraki Customer Support.

item.title: Load Times and Timeouts on Subscription Organization Dashboards [resolved]
item.description: The recent issue causing slow load times and intermittent timeouts for dashboard pages in subscription-based organizations has been resolved. System performance has returned to normal, and all affected services are operating as expected. If you continue to experience any issues, please contact our support team for further assistance.
